#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Record exact finite source deltas and original declarations; run no runtime."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PREFIX = Path("Tools/PinkhaDualEngineRuntime/hosted_core13")
DOCS = ROOT / "after/docs/validation/20261127-hosted-core16-rtl-same-job"
BASE = ROOT / "before" / PREFIX
AFTER = ROOT / "after" / PREFIX


def pin(data):
    return {"bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
            "gitBlob": hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()}


def retain(name, value):
    data = (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    with (DOCS / name).open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(data)
    return {"path": name, **pin(data)}


def source_declarations(raw):
    lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
    def extract(node):
        first = min([node.lineno, *[item.lineno for item in node.decorator_list]])
        return b"".join(lines[first - 1:node.end_lineno])
    output = {}
    for node in ast.parse(raw).body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
            output[node.name] = extract(node)
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                for child in node.body:
                    if isinstance(child, ast.FunctionDef):
                        output[node.name + "." + child.name] = extract(child)
    return output


def inverse_record(before, after):
    old, new = before.splitlines(keepends=True), after.splitlines(keepends=True)
    operations = []
    for tag, a, b, c, d in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, old, new, autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
        if tag != "equal":
            operations.append({"beforeLineRange0": [a, b], "afterLineRange0": [c, d],
                               "before": b"".join(old[a:b]).decode(), "after": b"".join(new[c:d]).decode()})
    restored = list(new)
    for operation in reversed(operations):
        c, d = operation["afterLineRange0"]
        assert b"".join(restored[c:d]) == operation["after"].encode()
        restored[c:d] = operation["before"].encode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    assert b"".join(restored) == before
    return {"before": pin(before), "after": pin(after), "operations": operations,
            "fullLiteralInverseExact": True}


def final_body(raw, name):
    node = next(n for n in ast.parse(raw).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)
    tries = [n for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n, ast.Try) and n.finalbody]
    if name == "run":
        tries = [n for n in tries if any(isinstance(part, ast.Attribute) and part.attr == "observe_owned_groups"
                 for statement in n.finalbody for part in ast.walk(statement))]
    assert len(tries) == 1
    lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
    first, last = tries[0].finalbody[0], tries[0].finalbody[-1]
    return b"".join(lines[first.lineno - 1:last.end_lineno])


def main():
    manifest = json.loads((AFTER / "original_sources.json").read_bytes())
    assert len(manifest["files"]) == 15
    assert "Tools/CurrentAppleValidation/combined_heart_semantics/wave2/rtl-witness-current/native_compiler_witness.py" in manifest["files"]
    assert "Tools/CurrentAppleValidation/combined_heart_semantics/wave2/rtl_hosted_profile.py" not in manifest["files"]
    names = ("README.md", "admission.py", "original_sources.json", "originals.py", "run.py", "test_control.py")
    deltas, patch, files = {}, [], {}
    for name in names:
        before, after = (BASE / name).read_bytes(), (AFTER / name).read_bytes()
        files[str(PREFIX / name)] = {"before": pin(before), "after": pin(after), "changed": before != after}
        if before != after:
            deltas[str(PREFIX / name)] = inverse_record(before, after)
            patch.extend(difflib.unified_diff(before.decode().splitlines(keepends=True), after.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),
                         fromfile="a/" + str(PREFIX / name), tofile="b/" + str(PREFIX / name)))
    assert len(deltas) == 5 and not files[str(PREFIX / "admission.py")]["changed"]
    old_run, new_run = (BASE / "run.py").read_bytes(), (AFTER / "run.py").read_bytes()
    original, updated = source_declarations(old_run), source_declarations(new_run)
    protected = ("CommandAdmission", "retain_receipt", "select_runtime", "fresh_toolchain", "clone_products",
                 "verify_created_device", "lane_summary", "include_lane_cleanup", "main")
    assert all(original[name] == updated[name] for name in protected)
    assert {name for name in original if original[name] != updated[name]} == {"execute_lane", "run"}
    assert set(updated).difference(original) == {"source_contract_for_lane"}
    final_bodies = {}
    for name in ("execute_lane", "run"):
        a, b = final_body(old_run, name), final_body(new_run, name)
        assert a == b
        final_bodies[name] = pin(b)
    old_tests, new_tests = source_declarations((BASE / "test_control.py").read_bytes()), source_declarations((AFTER / "test_control.py").read_bytes())
    old_methods = {name: value for name, value in old_tests.items() if ".test_" in name}
    changed_methods = [name for name in old_methods if old_methods[name] != new_tests[name]]
    assert changed_methods == ["HostedCore13ControlTests.test_exact_original_declarations_and_thirteen_method_scope"]
    assert len(old_methods) == 8 and len([name for name in new_tests if ".test_" in name]) == 9
    unchanged_methods = {name: pin(value) for name, value in old_methods.items() if value == new_tests[name]}
    assert len(unchanged_methods) == 7
    inverse = retain("source-inverse.json", {"schema": "pinkha-hosted-core16-rtl-literal-inverse-v1",
        "baseSource": "e8b5b8fec5267468514d343e988496ed5797c755", "files": deltas,
        "admissionWholeFileUnchanged": files[str(PREFIX / "admission.py")]["after"],
        "protectedRuntimeDeclarations": {name: pin(updated[name]) for name in protected},
        "existingFinallyBodiesUnchanged": final_bodies, "sevenOriginalPortableMethodsUnchanged": unchanged_methods,
        "swiftBodiesChanged": 0, "originalValidatorBodiesChanged": 0, "runtimeTestsExecuted": 0})
    patch = "".join(patch)
    diff = retain("source.patch.json", {"schema": "pinkha-exact-source-diff-envelope-v1", "encoding": "utf-8",
        "bytes": len(patch.encode()), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(patch.encode()).hexdigest(), "patch": patch})
    sys.path.insert(0, str(AFTER))
    from originals import Originals
    import run
    originals = Originals(ROOT / "original")
    try:
        originals.install()
        assert len(originals.proof["declarations"]) == 46
        declarations = retain("original-controller-declarations.json", originals.proof)
        contracts = {lane: originals.native_core.fixed_contract(lane) for lane in run.LANES[:-1]}
        rtl = originals.rtl
        contracts["rtl-hosted"] = {"kind": "rtl-hosted", "sourceInventoryOnly": True,
            "expected_methods": rtl.METHOD_COUNT, "declared_cases": rtl.CASE_COUNT,
            "originalSuiteDefinitions": rtl.SUITES, "product_source_hashes": rtl.PRODUCT_SOURCES,
            "compiled_identifiers": sorted(rtl.TARGET + "/" + suite + "/" + name + "("
                + "".join(parameter["name"] + ":" for parameter in definition["parameters"]) + ")"
                for suite, specification in rtl.SUITES.items() for name, definition in specification["methods"].items())}
        assert sum(c["expected_methods"] for c in contracts.values()) == 22
        assert sum(c["declared_cases"] for c in contracts.values()) == 26
        for lane, contract in contracts.items():
            contracts[lane]["originalInvocationSelectors"] = originals.host_functions.invocation_selectors(contract["compiled_identifiers"], contract)
        methods = retain("original-method-contracts.json", {"schema": "pinkha-hosted-core16-rtl-source-scope-v1",
            "methods": 22, "cases": 26, "lanes": contracts, "sourceInventoryOnly": True,
            "actualEnumerationPerformed": False, "runtimeTestsExecuted": 0})
        originals.unchanged()
    finally:
        originals.close()
    for name in ("renderer16-independent-review.json", "renderer16-independent-byte-proof.json", "rtl-current-editor-root-review.json"):
        destination = DOCS / name
        assert not destination.exists()
        shutil.copyfile(ROOT / "upstream-reviews" / name, destination)
    destination = DOCS / "witness-pair-independent-review.json"
    assert not destination.exists()
    shutil.copyfile(ROOT / "new-witness-review/source-pair-review.json", destination)
    summary = {"files": files, "inverse": inverse, "diff": diff,
               "declarations": declarations, "methods": methods}
    with (ROOT / "source-evidence-index.json").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"changedSourceFiles": len(deltas), "unchangedLifecycleDeclarations": len(protected),
                      "inverse": inverse, "declarations": declarations, "methods": methods}, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
